jra.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT r.id,r.race_date,r.surface,r.turn,r.going,r.distance,r.field_size,r.class_name,r.course_layout,h.horse_no,h.finish,h.final3f,CASE WHEN h.time_raw~'^[0-9]+:[0-5][0-9][.][0-9]$' THEN split_part(h.time_raw,':',1)::numeric*60+split_part(h.time_raw,':',2)::numeric END AS sec FROM public.jra_lab_races r JOIN public.jra_lab_runs h ON h.race_id=r.id WHERE r.full_field AND r.source_kind='jra_public_reference' AND h.record_role='full_runner' AND h.source_kind='jra_public_reference' AND r.race_date>=DATE '2024-01-01' AND r.race_date<DATE '2026-09-01' AND r.surface IN ('芝','ダート')), g AS (SELECT id,race_date,surface,turn,going,distance,field_size,class_name,course_layout,count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT horse_no) AS uniq,count(DISTINCT finish) FILTER(WHERE finish>0) AS finishes,min(finish) AS lo,max(finish) AS hi,count(sec) AS clocks,min(sec) AS min_clock,min(sec) FILTER(WHERE finish=1) AS winner_clock,count(*) FILTER(WHERE finish=1) AS winners,count(*) FILTER(WHERE final3f>0 AND final3f<sec) AS f3n,array_agg(sec ORDER BY finish,horse_no)=array_agg(sec ORDER BY sec) AS clock_order FROM f GROUP BY id,race_date,surface,turn,going,distance,field_size,class_name,course_layout), e AS (SELECT *, n=field_size AND uniq=n AND finishes=n AND lo=1 AND hi=n AND clocks=n AND winners=1 AND min_clock=winner_clock AND min_clock>0 AS candidate FROM g) SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE candidate) AS clock_candidates,sum(n) FILTER(WHERE candidate) AS candidate_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE candidate AND f3n=n) AS valid_f3_races,sum(n) FILTER(WHERE candidate AND f3n=n) AS valid_f3_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE candidate AND f3n=n AND clock_order) AS strict_races,sum(n) FILTER(WHERE candidate AND f3n=n AND clock_order) AS strict_rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE candidate AND f3n=n AND clock_order AND turn IN ('左','右','直線') AND going IN ('良','稍重','重','不良') AND distance>0 AND nullif(btrim(class_name),'') IS NOT NULL) AS strict_condition_races,sum(n) FILTER(WHERE candidate AND f3n=n AND clock_order AND turn IN ('左','右','直線') AND going IN ('良','稍重','重','不良') AND distance>0 AND nullif(btrim(class_name),'') IS NOT NULL) AS strict_condition_rows FROM e

collision_audit.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT h.jockey_ref,h.jockey,h.horse_ref,h.horse_name,r.source_checked_at FROM public.jra_lab_races r JOIN public.jra_lab_runs h ON h.race_id=r.id WHERE r.track='東京' AND r.surface='ダート' AND r.race_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' AND r.race_date<DATE '2026-01-01' AND r.full_field AND r.source_kind='jra_public_reference' AND h.record_role='full_runner' AND h.source_kind='jra_public_reference'), j AS (SELECT jockey_ref,count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT jockey) AS names FROM f WHERE nullif(btrim(jockey_ref),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY jockey_ref), h AS (SELECT horse_ref,count(*) AS n,count(DISTINCT horse_name) AS names FROM f WHERE nullif(btrim(horse_ref),'') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY horse_ref) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM f) AS rows,(SELECT count(DISTINCT jockey) FROM f) AS jockey_names,(SELECT count(*) FROM j) AS jockey_refs,(SELECT count(*) FROM j WHERE names>1) AS jockey_ref_collisions,(SELECT max(names) FROM j) AS max_jockey_names_per_ref,(SELECT count(DISTINCT horse_name) FROM f) AS horse_names,(SELECT count(*) FROM h) AS horse_refs,(SELECT count(*) FROM h WHERE names>1) AS horse_ref_collisions,(SELECT max(names) FROM h) AS max_horse_names_per_ref
